description: What's in the signed-in member's supply cart right now: each item with its option, quantity, current price and stock, and the items total per store (before shipping and tax). The cart is the same one they fill on the website's product pages, so call this whenever they mention their cart or what they added. To change it, use update_supply_cart; to buy it, request_supply_quote with from_cart.
name: my_supply_cart
title: Your supply cart
